The [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wore [[Color/Legends|green]]<ref name="TUR" /> twelve centimeters tall wraparound<ref name="OBF" /> '''traditional masks'''<ref name="TUR" /> that reached from their cheekbones to above the top of their heads to intimidate others.<ref name="OBF" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].</ref> the [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|Miskara]], the ruler of the [[Vagaari Empire]], and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[The Miskara's flagship|flagship's]] crew wore masks. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]], who offered the Miskara the location of a [[Crustai asteroid base|Chiss base]], saw the<ref name="OBF" /> traditional<ref name="TUR" /> masks and believed that they were designed to compensate for the Vagaari's shortness to make them look more intimidating.<ref name="OBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari masks first appeared in the [[2007]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OBF" />
